## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the invite validator before merge: the pull request says it raises the minimum "in the password validators," but `app/invite.py` still accepts 8-character passwords, so the invite path does not enforce the new policy.

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/reset.py` and `app/signup.py`, moves the boundary tests for both modules to lengths 11, 12 and 13, and adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator minimum to twelve — An 8- to 11-character password is still accepted on the invite path, because `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while signup and reset now require 12. The test at `tests/test_invite.py:6-8` still asserts `length >= 8`, so it locks in the old minimum. — Users who join through an invite can set passwords shorter than the twelve characters your security policy now requires. — Fix: Set `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and update `tests/test_invite.py` the same way you updated `tests/test_signup.py`, or move the constant into one shared module so the three validators cannot drift apart.
